meta_title: {brand}: automated sales outreach in your customer's language
meta_description: {brand} automates sales outreach: it finds potential customers, writes personal messages in their language, sends them from your accounts and follows up.
hero_title: Find new customers, in their language
hero_text: Tell {brand} about your business once. It finds potential customers, writes to each one in their language from your own email and WhatsApp, and follows up for you.
example_body: Hi Maria, I noticed your team ships fresh produce abroad. We make export boxes built to arrive in one piece. Would a short call next week be useful? Reply STOP if you would rather not hear from us.

steps.title: Tell us about your business
steps.text: Answer a few plain questions: what you sell and who you want to reach. Upload your contact list, or connect a lead-search provider.

steps.title: Check the plan and the messages
steps.text: The AI prepares your first campaign and writes the messages. You read them, change what you like, and nothing is sent until you launch.

steps.title: Launch and read the replies
steps.text: Messages go out from your accounts and follow-ups are sent for you. Replies arrive in one inbox, and follow-ups stop when someone answers.

features.title: Personal, not bulk
features.text: Each message is written for the person and the company receiving it, using the facts you give about your business.

features.title: In their language
features.text: Messages are written in the recipient's language, including English, Arabic, Spanish, Portuguese, German and Dutch.

features.title: From your own accounts
features.text: Email goes from your mailbox and WhatsApp from your business number, so people recognise who is writing.

features.title: Follow-ups that know when to stop
features.text: Polite reminders go out on a schedule and stop as soon as the person replies.

features.title: Opt-outs respected
features.text: When someone asks to stop, in many languages, they are added to your do-not-contact list and checked before every send.

features.title: You stay in control
features.text: Review campaigns before launch, pause them at any time, and see what was sent and to whom.

audience_title: Made for businesses without a tech team
audience: Other companies that sell to businesses
trust: Contact only people you are allowed to contact. WhatsApp requires their agreement before you message them.
Every company's data is kept separate from every other company's.
Keys for your connected accounts are stored encrypted.
pricing_text: We are finalising our plans. Prices will be shown in your local currency, with any taxes that apply. Tell us about your business and we will send you the details.

faq.a: The AI writes messages in the recipient's language. The product's own screens are currently in English.

faq.a: From you: your mailbox and your WhatsApp business number.

compare_title: A message written for them gets read

generic_body: Dear Sir/Madam, we are a leading supplier of quality products at the best prices. Kindly contact us for your requirements.

about_text: {brand} automates sales outreach for businesses that sell to other businesses. You describe your business once. It finds potential customers through the lead-search account you connect, or works from your list, writes a personal message to each in their language, sends it from your own email and WhatsApp accounts and follows up. You check the campaign first, and nothing is sent until you launch. {brand} is made by {company}.
signup_meta_title: Sign up for {brand}: personal outreach for your business
signup_meta_description: How to create your {brand} account: what you need, what happens next and how to start your first campaign by email and WhatsApp.
signup_text: An account is for your company. You need your name, your company name, a work email and a password of at least 12 characters.
signup_steps_title: What happens when you sign up

signup_steps.title: Create the account
signup_steps.text: Enter your details and accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

signup_steps.title: Pay the one-time sign-up fee
signup_steps.text: A single payment opens your account. In India you can pay by UPI, including BHIM, card or netbanking; elsewhere by card.

signup_steps.title: Set up and launch
signup_steps.text: Tell the AI about your business, check the first campaign and its messages, then launch when you are happy.

signup_closed: Online sign-up is opening soon. Send us a short email and we will tell you when your account can be created.
signup_fee_text: One-time sign-up fee: {inr} in India (GST included) or {usd} elsewhere. It is not a subscription.
pricing_open_text: Monthly plans are being finalised. Any further price is shown before you pay it, with the taxes that apply.
final_open_text: Create your account and the AI helps you prepare your first campaign.

faq_more.a: After you launch a campaign, it finds potential customers through your lead-search account or uses your list, writes and sends personal messages, sends follow-ups, stops them when someone replies and honours requests to stop.
Not yet. When someone replies, follow-ups stop and the reply appears in your inbox for you to answer. AI answers with a handover to you are planned.

faq_more.q: Is anything sent without my approval?
faq_more.a: No. You check the campaign and its messages first, and nothing is sent until you launch. After that, follow-ups go out on schedule and stop when someone replies.

faq_more.q: Do I need my own email and WhatsApp accounts?
faq_more.a: Yes. Messages go out from your own mailbox and your WhatsApp business number, and you pay those providers directly. WhatsApp requires the recipient's agreement before you message them.

faq_more.q: Is my data kept separate from other companies?
faq_more.a: Yes. Each company's data is separated in the database, and the keys of your connected accounts are stored encrypted.

languages_text: Each person gets the message in their own language. The same idea, written naturally.
example_reply: Thursday works for us. Please send the details.
